command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . (Feature Mixer harness)

tests.name: tests.test_dependencies.DependencyTests.test_standard_library_only
tests.expected: the unified package imports only the standard library and itself

tests.name: tests.test_identity.ModuleTests.test_concurrent_registration_one_winner
tests.expected: concurrent registrations of one email create exactly one account

tests.name: tests.test_identity.ModuleTests.test_interface_and_file_import
tests.expected: create_app, AuthError and every interface method exist; identity.py also loads as a plain file

tests.name: tests.test_identity.OAuthTests.test_oauth_email_verified_must_be_true
tests.expected: truthy non-boolean values such as "true", "false", 1 never count as verified

tests.name: tests.test_identity.OAuthTests.test_oauth_input_validated
tests.expected: empty or non-string provider or subject, and malformed emails, raise AuthError

tests.name: tests.test_identity.OAuthTests.test_oauth_new_user_is_viewer_and_stable
tests.expected: a new provider identity gets one viewer account, returned again on the next sign-in

tests.name: tests.test_identity.OAuthTests.test_oauth_unverified_does_not_claim_email
tests.expected: an unverified provider email does not block the real owner from registering

tests.name: tests.test_identity.OAuthTests.test_oauth_unverified_email_creates_separate_account
tests.expected: a provider sign-in with the same but unverified email gets a separate viewer account

tests.name: tests.test_identity.OAuthTests.test_oauth_verified_email_links_existing_account
tests.expected: a provider sign-in with the same verified email returns a token for the same account, role kept

tests.name: tests.test_identity.OAuthTests.test_oauth_verified_new_user_owns_email
tests.expected: once a verified provider account owns an email, password registration of it is refused and a second

tests.name: tests.test_identity.OAuthTests.test_oauth_without_email_creates_separate_account
tests.expected: a provider sign-in without an email never links and has email None

tests.name: tests.test_identity.OAuthTests.test_same_subject_different_providers_are_different_identities
tests.expected: identities are keyed by (provider, subject)

tests.name: tests.test_identity.PasswordTests.test_duplicate_registration_refused
tests.expected: a second registration of the same email (any case) raises AuthError and the first password still works

tests.name: tests.test_identity.PasswordTests.test_email_case_normalised
tests.expected: emails are trimmed and lowercased for sign-up, login and linking

tests.name: tests.test_identity.PasswordTests.test_login_failures_raise_autherror
tests.expected: wrong password, unknown email and malformed input all raise AuthError with the same message

tests.name: tests.test_identity.PasswordTests.test_password_stored_hashed_with_salt
tests.expected: no plaintext password is stored; PBKDF2-SHA256 with a 16-byte random salt and 100000 iterations

tests.name: tests.test_identity.PasswordTests.test_register_and_login_password
tests.expected: register returns an id; login returns a token; whoami shows the id, normalised email and role editor

tests.name: tests.test_identity.PasswordTests.test_registration_input_validated
tests.expected: invalid emails and empty or non-string passwords are refused with AuthError (a ValueError)

tests.name: tests.test_identity.PasswordTests.test_user_ids_are_opaque_strings
tests.expected: every user id is a unique opaque text id, not a source's counter

tests.name: tests.test_identity.RoleChangeTests.test_admin_sets_role
tests.expected: an admin changes another user's role and it shows at once; unknown roles and users are refused

tests.name: tests.test_identity.RoleChangeTests.test_bootstrap_admin_only_once
tests.expected: the first bootstrap creates an admin; a second is refused while an admin exists

tests.name: tests.test_identity.RoleChangeTests.test_nobody_raises_own_role
tests.expected: viewers and editors cannot raise their own role; lowering is not raising

tests.name: tests.test_identity.RoleChangeTests.test_non_admin_cannot_set_role
tests.expected: viewers, editors and invalid sessions get PermissionError and nothing changes

tests.name: tests.test_identity.RoleChangeTests.test_role_change_needs_live_session
tests.expected: an admin's revoked or expired session cannot change roles

tests.name: tests.test_identity.SessionTests.test_logout_revokes_token
tests.expected: after logout whoami raises AuthError; other sessions stay valid; logout twice is harmless

tests.name: tests.test_identity.SessionTests.test_session_expires
tests.expected: a session older than its lifetime raises AuthError

tests.name: tests.test_identity.SessionTests.test_tokens_not_stored_in_clear
tests.expected: the session store keeps only a hash of each token

tests.name: tests.test_identity.SessionTests.test_whoami_invalid_token
tests.expected: unknown, empty and non-string tokens raise AuthError

tests.name: tests.test_journey.JourneyTests.test_journey_full_identity_flow
tests.expected: setup admin; a person signs up with a password, signs in with a verified provider email into the

tests.name: tests.test_roles.RoleMappingTests.test_map_source_role
tests.expected: A user->editor, B member->viewer, C roles unchanged; unknown roles and apps raise KeyError

tests.name: tests.test_roles.RoleMappingTests.test_no_source_role_maps_to_admin_except_roster_admin
tests.expected: only C's admin becomes admin; no source role is escalated

tests.name: tests.test_roles.RoleMappingTests.test_permission_check
tests.expected: viewer reads; editor reads and writes; only admin manages roles; unknown roles get nothing
